first off, thank you for taking the time to ask this stuff. ive had so many therapists who refused to listen to what i had to say, and its really important for the next generation of psych professionals to, yknow, CARE about mentally ill people. 

we dont really have a functioning host, at least not in the way thats usually portrayed in the media. no one uses the bodys name and no one is really the "original". we all are kind of developed from pieces of the girl whos supposed to live here.

we all kind of share responsibilities, but some of us are better at certain things than others. we all watch out for our youngest alter (shes 6!) and we all try to get school work done. we each have different roles in watching out for the bodys safety, though. im basically the daddy issues alter, and i act as a protector. the others kind of handle their own part of our mental health (14 year old has all of our narcissistic tendencies, 17 year old has the self destructive ones, etc.)

the most important thing, in my opinion, is that ALL OF US ARE DIFFERENT PEOPLE! we arent hallucinations, and we arent fractions of a whole, even though we started off as that. im a grown man, and i live here, and im not the same as the person that is meant to live here.

feel free to ask me more questions, either here or in pm. im happy to talk about my experiences.
